title: On the global convergence of gradient flow for wide shallow models beyond homogeneous nonlinearities
abstract: arXiv:2605.10775v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: A surprising phenomenon in the training of neural networks is the ability of gradient descent to find global minimizers of the training loss despite its non-convexity. Following earlier work, we investigate this behavior for wide shallow models. Existing global convergence results primarily concern models with positively one-homogeneous nonlinearities, such as ReLU activations, and models with scalar output weights and bounded nonlinearities, such as sigmoid activations. We study a broader class of models, including multi-head attention layers and two-layer fully connected networks with bounded or asymptotically positively one-homogeneous activations and vector output weights. translated_title: 关于超越齐次非线性的宽浅层模型梯度流的全局收敛性
translated_abstract: 神经网络训练中一个令人惊讶的现象是：尽管训练损失是非凸的，梯度下降却能够找到其全局极小值点。沿用先前的工作，我们针对宽浅层模型研究了这一现象。现有的全局收敛结果主要针对具有正一次齐次非线性的模型（如ReLU激活函数），以及具有标量输出权重和有界非线性（如sigmoid激活函数）的模型。我们研究了一类更广泛的模型，包括多头注意力层，以及具有有界或渐近正一次齐次激活函数和向量输出权重的两层全连接网络。基于 (Chizat and Bach, 2018) 的工作，通过构造“逃逸区域”，我们证明了在隐藏神经元或注意力头数量趋于无穷的极限下，训练损失的非极小值点在平均场梯度流动力学下是不稳定的。
tldr: 本文将神经网络梯度流的全局收敛性理论推广到超越齐次非线性和标量输出权重的更广泛模型类别（包括多头注意力层和向量输出权重的两层全连接网络），证明在无限宽极限下平均场梯度流会使训练损失的非极小值点不稳定。
en_tdlr: This paper extends global convergence theory for neural network gradient flow beyond homogeneous nonlinearities and scalar output weights—covering multi-head attention layers and two-layer fully connected networks with bounded or asymptotically positively one-homogeneous activations and vector output weights—by proving that non-minimizers of the training loss are unstable under mean-field gradient flow dynamics in the infinite-width limit.
